name: model-worklog-workspace
description: Local AI session logging and review

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:workspaces && npm run test:demo:web
scripts.test:rag: npm run build && tsc -p packages/adapter-sdk/tsconfig.test.json && node --test "packages/adapter-sdk/test-dist/rag/*.test.js" examples/rag/evaluation/metrics.test.mjs
scripts.test:rag:live: npm run build && tsc -p packages/adapter-sdk/tsconfig.test.json && node examples/rag/run-live-tests.mjs
scripts.release:check: npm run release:versions && npm run test && npm run test:browser && npm run demo:trace && npm run extension:install && npm run extension:test && npm run pack:check && npm run extension:package
scripts.pack:check: npm run build && npm pack --dry-run --workspace model-worklog-schema && npm pack --dry-run --workspace model-worklog-supervisor && npm pack --dry-run --workspace model-worklog && npm pack --dry-run --workspace model-worklog-sdk
scripts.test:rag:browser: npm run build && tsc -p packages/adapter-sdk/tsconfig.test.json && node examples/rag/run-live-tests.mjs --browser
